inputProvenance: Start images are original Phobos procedural drawings in the new Lixivar colours (pale sage frame, dark slate tank, copper-brown crystalliser), drawn with Pillow and sent base64; the LC-3 second pass and the struvite attempt started from earlier outputs by their PixelLab download URLs. No game or third-party imagery. The Agriculture 0.27.0 nutrient hopper starts from an original Pillow drawing in the Verdemorrow reservoir palette (charcoal frame, sage walls, cream lid); its E3 pass started from the selected E2 master resized to 96 px by nearest neighbour. The Manufacturing 0.19.0 acid round starts from original Pillow drawings in the Lixivar colours; the AT-3 pass started from the selected AT-2 master resized to 96 px by nearest neighbour.

lc3-leach-unit.method: Inside the drain funnel box (pixels x 44-65, y 60-81) the 100 pixels with hue 190-250 degrees, saturation >= 0.2 and value >= 0.2 (a blue ring that could read as a lamp) are set to steel grey: grey = round(0.95 * luminance + 12), blue channel + 4, luminance 0.299 R + 0.587 G + 0.114 B. Owner ruling of 29 September 2026: no painted indicators. No other pixel changed.

struvite.method: exact palette swap of the potassium sulfate sack, so struvite reads as its sibling in a different sack: body f1e9d1 -> d6dde6, cabdad -> a9b4c2, 83766e -> 6e7888; band 9aa588 -> b87848, 616550 -> 7c4a2c; outline, tie and alpha unchanged

leached-residue.method: per-pixel luminance map onto a damp dark grey-brown ramp (washed clay and magnesite); alpha and pixel placement unchanged

calcined-residue.method: per-pixel luminance map onto a pale neutral grey ramp (baked clay and magnesia); alpha and pixel placement unchanged

brine-salt-cake.method: per-pixel luminance map onto a warm cream ramp (rock salt and sodium carbonate), so it reads apart from the cool grey spent salt cake; alpha and pixel placement unchanged

roasted-calcine.method: per-pixel luminance map onto a rust red-brown ramp (iron and nickel oxides); alpha and pixel placement unchanged

epsom-salt.method: exact palette swap of the potassium sulfate sack's five colours: white sack, teal band; alpha and pixel placement unchanged

ammonium-sulfate.method: exact palette swap of the potassium sulfate sack's five colours: pale grey sack, amber band; alpha and pixel placement unchanged

olivine-leach-cake.method: per-pixel luminance map onto a pale grey-green ramp (silica gel and iron(II) sulfate); alpha and pixel placement unchanged

rejectedArchive: Nothing archived: the two empty phosphate outputs returned fully transparent canvases (nothing to keep), the rejected struvite pass is recorded below and remains in the provider gallery, and the LC-3 second pass is recorded below and remains in the provider gallery.

request.description: ORTHOGRAPHIC VERTICAL OVERHEAD PLAN VIEW. Camera directly above, looking straight down at the object's TOP SURFACE ONLY. The whole square canvas is the top of a spacecraft leach and crystallise unit installed in a square frame: a pale sage green painted steel frame with copper-brown corner brackets around a pale grey-green enamel deck lit from the upper left; upper left a large round dark slate leach tank seen from above with a bolted steel rim and a central agitator hub; upper right a copper-brown crystalliser drum lying horizontally with banded rings; a short steel pipe joining tank and drum; below the drum a grey condenser box with parallel steel coil lines; lower left a dark control plate; lower centre a round steel drain funnel; a small blue water flange on the left edge; a small yellow flange on the right edge; a small dark orange power socket on the bottom frame; a few scuffs and rivet dots. Utilitarian retro spaceship equipment: crisp dark outlines, small readable colour regions, restrained shading, sparse purposeful details, a little wear. No lights, no gauges, no perspective, no ground shadow, no text, numbers, symbols or logos.
